visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle close-up of a finished Japanese cream stew. Pieces of broccoli, carrots, onions, and chicken are coated in a thick white sauce. A pair of hands carefully places a piece of golden-brown, crispy fried chicken skin on top. The background is a simple wooden table. (2) The scene cuts to a black frying pan on an induction stove. Pink tongs place three pieces of pale, raw chicken skin onto the hot surface. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The chicken skins are shown frying until they turn deep golden and crispy. (4) Shimeji mushrooms are added to the same pan, which still has some chicken fat. They are tossed around with the pink tongs. (5) Chunks of raw chicken thigh meat are added to the pan with the mushrooms and spread out to sear. (6) Salt and black pepper are sprinkled over the chicken from clear glass seasoning containers. (7) Large chunks of white onion, bright orange carrots, and pale yellow potatoes are added. The cook uses tongs to mix everything together in the pan. (8) Clear water is poured from a white pitcher into the pan, submerging the ingredients halfway to simmer. (9) In a separate pan, a block of yellow butter is melted, and white flour is added. A blue silicone spatula stirs them into a smooth, thick roux. (10) The simmered chicken and vegetables are poured into the roux pan. (11) A bowl of white heavy cream is poured in, followed by green broccoli florets. Everything is stirred together with the blue spatula. (12) The final dish is presented again in the pan, with more crispy chicken skin added on top by hand.
